title: The Energy That Made Everything Happen
intro: This quiz follows Mira and Jay as they discover different forms of energy and how energy can change from one form into another.

choices: The amount of space an object takes up
The ability to do work or cause change
questions.explanation: Energy is the ability to do work or cause change.

questions.prompt: What type of energy is stored in a battery?
questions.explanation: Chemical energy is stored in a battery.

questions.prompt: What happens to the chemical energy in a battery when it powers a device?
choices: It changes only into sound energy
questions.explanation: The chemical energy in a battery changes into electrical energy when it powers a device.

questions.prompt: Why did the raised book have gravitational potential energy?
choices: It was held high above the table
It was connected to a battery
questions.explanation: The raised book had gravitational potential energy because it was held high above the table.

questions.prompt: Which sequence correctly describes the energy changes in a flashlight?
choices: Light energy → chemical energy → electrical energy
Chemical energy → electrical energy → light and some heat energy
Sound energy → motion energy → light energy
Heat energy → chemical energy → sound energy
questions.explanation: In a flashlight, chemical energy changes into electrical energy, which then becomes light and some heat energy.
